chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:

The example of salat (prayer) is like the central pole of a tent: if the pole is firmly established, the ropes, pegs, and covering remain firm; and if the pole breaks, then neither a peg, nor a rope, nor a covering is of any use.

key_terms.الصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the central act of worship being emphasized
key_terms.الْأَطْنَابُ: the tent ropes that depend on the central pole
key_terms.الْأَوْتَادُ: the pegs that secure the tent
key_terms.الْغِشَاءُ: the tent covering or outer fabric
key_terms.الْفُسْطَاطِ: the tent, used here as the image for an organized structure
key_terms.انْكَسَرَ: broke or was broken, indicating collapse of the central support
key_terms.عَمُودِ: the supporting pillar or central pole

ai.seo_question: Why is salat compared to the central pole of a tent in hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith presents salat (prayer) as the central support of a believer’s religious life. Just as a tent cannot stand without its main pole, other deeds lose their sustaining structure when salat is neglected.
